title: Fed Emergency Rate Cut
description: Illustrative inter-meeting Fed cut in response to a sudden growth scare. Directionally anchored on the verified COVID 2020 (TLT +14%) and SVB 2023 (TLT +5%, GLD +9%) windows.
transmission: A sudden growth scare hits markets
The Fed cuts rates between meetings
Yields fall sharply and the dollar weakens
Bonds and gold rally; equities stay volatile
